business_scope.primary_industry_name: Digital Intermediary for Regulated Startup Equity Offerings

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Panama (Republic of Panama; unitary jurisdiction administered from Panama City; national centralized Public Registry)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law codified system with pronounced Anglo-American corporate and securities law influence; unitary, non-federal state)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Panama Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 26 October 1982, entered into force 10 May 1991)
US-Panama Trade Promotion Agreement, Chapter 10 on Investment (entered into force 31 October 2012)
Panama-Spain Double Taxation Convention (entered into force 2011)
Panama-France Double Taxation Convention (entered into force 2011)
Panama-Netherlands Double Taxation Convention (entered into force 2012)
Panama-Mexico Double Taxation Convention (entered into force 2011)
Panama-Republic of Korea Double Taxation Convention (entered into force 2016)
Panama-Singapore Double Taxation Convention (entered into force 2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 23 of 27 April 2015 (AML/CFT framework, as amended), Unified Text of Law 23 of 2015 (Gaceta Oficial of 28 December 2018) and Executive Decree 363 of 21 July 2015; Law 52 of 3 December 2016 (Fintech and crowdfunding regulatory mandate); Law 129 of 20 July 2020 (Beneficial Owner Registry, inserting Articles 54-A through 54-F of the Fiscal Code) implemented by Executive Decree 191 of 14 September 2020; Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SMV) equity crowdfunding portal regulation (Acuerdo No. 3 of 2019 as amended); Law 63 of 4 August 2021 (Corporations Act, reforming Law 32 of 1927); supervising authorities: Unidad de Analisis Financiero (UAF), Superintendencia de Sujetos No Financieros (SSNF) and Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SMV).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each shareholder and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or competent civil registry / consulate of the shareholder's or director's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuer is within a contracting state; otherwise consular legalization at the Consulate of Panama in the country of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incumbency of corporate shareholder (if any shareholder is a legal entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry and/or registered agent in the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization before the Panamanian authorities; translation into Spanish by a certified Panamanian public translator where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified corporate resolution of the shareholder entity authorizing the incorporation of the Panama S.A. and appointing its directors and officers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors or corporate secretary of the shareholder entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, plus notarization of signatures

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds / asset and income declaration for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank or external auditor of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization combined with Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Final Beneficiary pre-filing declaration data sheet (Declaracion de Beneficiario Final) and registered agent KYC questionnaire
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian registered agent / retained law firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal onboarding instrument; no apostille required, executed under signature and retained in the registered agent's AML file

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, UBOs and controlling parties against: (i) the national PEP and criminal-financial lists maintained by the UAF under Executive Decree 363 of 2015; (ii) OFAC SDN and FSE lists; (iii) the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list; (iv) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list; and (v) FATF public statements and debarment databases. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandatory for PEPs, family members and close associates of PEPs, and for high-risk jurisdictions. Continuous transaction and relationship monitoring is required under Articles 20-23 of Law 23 of 2015; any adverse hit triggers refusal or escalation to the compliance committee and, where required, a suspicious transaction report to the UAF. The crowdfunding portal's own AML program must also satisfy SMV examination standards before licensing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Publico de Panama (Public Registry of Panama) - online corporate name search and name deposit module, https://www.registropublico.gob.pa/
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish is the official language of the Republic; corporate names may be expressed in any language provided they are written in Latin script, are readable in Spanish, and are not confusingly similar (doctrine of 'diformidad') to any name already registered. Numerals may be used only in Latin-script form. The corporate ending must identify limited-liability status (e.g., S.A., Inc., Corp., Ltd.).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Bank (prior Superintendencia de Bancos de Panama approval required)
Trust / Fiduciaria (prior SSNF or banking license approval required)
Seguros / Reaseguros (prior Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros approval required)
Bolsa de Valores / Exchange (prior SMV approval required)
Fondo de Inversion / Investment Fund (prior SMV authorization required)
Gobierno / Nacional / Republica / Municipal (government-affiliated tokens prohibited)
Cruz Roja / Red Cross and other protected emblems
Crowdfunding / Financiamiento Colectivo (requires prior SMV licensing opinion before name clearance)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The name reservation (Certificado de Deposito de Nombre) issued by the Public Registry is valid for thirty (30) calendar days and cannot be administratively extended; renewal requires filing a new request with a new statutory fee. If the name is rejected on grounds of similarity, prohibited token, or illegibility, the registered agent must obtain the Registrador's written objection and may file a re-examination request within five (5) business days. If the objection is upheld, an administrative appeal (recurso de apelacion) may be filed with the Director General of the Public Registry within ten (10) business days, followed, if necessary, by judicial review before the competent administrative litigation chamber (Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo) of the Corte Suprema de Justicia. Pending appeal, the applicant may concurrently reserve one alternative name to preserve the incorporation timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For purely corporate-law purposes, the statutory registered office may be the office of the resident agent (a licensed attorney or licensed corporate service provider), and a virtual address is tolerated. However, an equity crowdfunding portal licensed by the SMV must maintain a physical operational office in Panama, employ a resident compliance officer, keep books and records accessible from that office, and demonstrate real commercial substance during licensing review. A virtual office therefore is not sufficient for the licensed crowdfunding activity.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High - greater than 75% estimated probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the SMV, jointly with the SSNF/UAF, within the first 24 months of licensing; crowdfunding portals are treated as high-risk licensed financial intermediaries, and resident agents are additionally subject to periodic SSNF on-site examinations, making prematurely or improperly documented incorporations vulnerable to inspection-driven rescission.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and deposit (Certificado de Deposito de Nombre)
Notarial protocolization of the Pacto Social / Escritura de Constitucion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public of the Republic of Panama

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal drafting of the full bilingual incorporation package (charter, bylaws, opening minutes, UBO forms)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Retained counsel / registered agent law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for fintech S.A. incorporations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Public Registry filing and inscription fee for the newly formed company
Registered agent appointment, registered office service and first-year statutory compliance retainer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for annual registered agent service

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC due diligence, UBO piercing analysis and sanctions/PEP screening (World-Check, OFAC, UN, EU databases)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance / KYC service provider and resident agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for fintech onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial Owner Registry pre-draft and DGI registration submission (Law 129 of 2020)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Direccion General de Ingresos (DGI) plus processing agent fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative fee plus agent handling charge

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (Law 32 of 1927), as amended, Title I (Articles 1–10), Article 20 (registration), and Article 53 (piercing the corporate veil). For the crowdfunding license, additionally Acuerdo 11-2016 of the Securities Market Superintendency.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección de Personas Jurídicas (Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) containing the Pacto Social and Estatutos
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum under the General Law; the Articles of Incorporation must state subscribed capital. Under Acuerdo 11-2016, an Equity Crowdfunding Portal must maintain net capital of at least USD 50,000, evidenced by an escrow deposit in a Panamanian licensed bank.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation subscribes its authorized share capital as stated in the Articles of Incorporation, and that the subscription consideration be deposited in escrow at a licensed Panamanian bank as required for the Equity Crowdfunding Portal license. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the registered office be and hereby is fixed at [Address], Panama, and that the registered agent, Morgan Escobar & Associates, is approved. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the following officers are appointed: Chief Executive Officer, Compliance Officer, and Secretary-Treasurer, each with standard powers and indemnification. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that management is directed to file all statutory filings and to apply for the crowdfunding portal license.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Notarize the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed attorney to draft the Escritura Pública de Constitución. The deed must include the S.A. name, corporate purpose covering financial technology and crowdfunding intermediation, capital structure, registered agent appointment, and bylaws. Submit the draft to the notary for review and execute the deed before the notary with all subscribing shareholders or their attorney-in-fact. The notary will authenticate the deed and assign an instrument number.
required_dossiers: Draft Public Deed of Incorporation
Copy of identification documents (cédula/passport) of shareholders and directors
Notarized power of attorney for each subscriber (if signing by representative)
Certificate of good standing of any corporate shareholder
Payment of notary fees and stamp tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies deficiencies (e.g., incomplete corporate purpose or invalid capital description), cure by filing an amendment deed (Otrosí) or redrafting the relevant clause. If the name is rejected due to conflict, reserve a new name and re-execute the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the Corporation with the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Escritura Pública de Constitución to the Public Registry for inscription in the Mercantile Registry. The Registry will review the deed for legality, issue a registration number, and record the entity. Upon registration, the company acquires legal personality. Also register the registered agent appointment (Resolución de Agente Residente).
required_dossiers: Original notarized Public Deed of Incorporation
Filing fee payment receipt (USD 250 standard)
Official form of registration request (Solicitud de Inscripción)
Registered agent acceptance letter
Copy of the attorney's or agent's identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query (personal/requerimiento) due to errors in the deed or missing annexes, file a corrective brief within 10 business days, attaching the required documentation and paying any reactivation fee. If the deed is rejected, execute a corrective deed before the notary and re-submit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Tax Identification Number (RUC) and Company Operating Notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Ministry of Economy and Finance, online via SITI/ATY system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, apply for the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) through the DGI online portal (SITI) or in person at the Charles M. Fergusson Building in Panama City. Complete Form 501 (Inscripción del Contribuyente), list the crowdfunding portal activity under the appropriate economic activity code (ISIC 6499), and obtain the Aviso de Operación. Withhold and register for payroll as the company recruits officers.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registration from Public Registry (Ficha Registral)
Public Deed of Incorporation (notarized copy)
Identity documents of legal representative
Registered office address verification (lease or deed)
Form 501 – RUC Registration Form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is stopped, verify economic activity codes and address documentation; amend Form 501 and submit corrections. If the Aviso de Operación is delayed, escalate to DGI Revenue Office with proof of payment and registered address.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Municipal Operating License and Fire Safety Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality of Panama (Alcaldía) – Directorate of Commercial Licenses; Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Aviso de Operación at the municipal office where the registered office is located. Submit the RUC, Public Registry certificate, and address documentation, and pay municipal tax (including annual patent). In parallel, schedule a fire safety inspection for the physical office premises and obtain the Certificado de Seguridad Contra Incendios from the Fire Department.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate and tax registration form
Public Registry certificate (Certificado de Persona Jurídica)
Copy of lease agreement or title for the office space
Fire safety inspection request form
Floor plan and building occupancy certificate
Payment of municipal patent fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Municipality refuses due to zoning or use violations, request a special administrative use permit (Excepción de Uso No Conforme). For fire code deficiencies, rectify evacuation routes, signage, or extinguishers and re-inspect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for Equity Crowdfunding Portal License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores de Panamá (SMV) – Directorate of Intermediaries and Market Participants
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the formal application for a Portal de Financiamiento Colectivo license to the SMV, using the SMV-701 form prescribed by Acuerdo 11-2016. Attach the incorporation documents, RUC, proof of escrow deposit of USD 50,000, compliance program (AML/KYC), operational platform description, cybersecurity protocols, insurance policy, and organizational chart. The SMV will conduct a technical and financial review, followed by an on-site inspection of the platform operations.
required_dossiers: SMV-701 application form, duly notarized
Certified copy of Public Deed of Incorporation and bylaws
RUC certificate and Aviso de Operación
Proof of paid-in capital in escrow (USD 50,000 minimum)
AML/CFT written compliance manual
Description of the electronic platform and IT security procedures
Insurance certificate for cyber liability and errors & omissions
Background and good standing certificates of directors and officers
Legal opinion from a Panamanian attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SMV identifies gaps, it will issue a requerimiento (observations). Submit corrective documentation within 15 business days. If denied, file a reconsideration petition or appeal before the SMV Board of Directors; ultimately to the Third Administrative Court of the Supreme Court. Engage an attorney and possibly a compliance consultancy to address findings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register with Labor Authorities and Obtain Workplace Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL); Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) – Dirección de Riesgos Profesionales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with MITRADEL as an employer, enroll employees with the CSS, and obtain the occupational health and safety clearance. Submit the workplace risk assessment (evaluación de riesgos) and the payroll registration form (Form 41). A physical workplace inspection may be required for offices with more than 10 employees.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate and Aviso de Operación
Company registration with MITRADEL (Form EMP-1)
Employee payroll list and employment contracts
CSS employer registration and form 41
Workplace risk assessment report
Fire safety certificate
Occupational health plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MITRADEL or CSS flags deficiencies, submit missing forms electronically or in person. If the workplace clearance is denied, follow the inspector's corrective recommendations and request reinspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores de Panamá (SMV) – Directorate of Intermediaries and Market Participants
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Portal de Financiamiento Colectivo (Equity Crowdfunding Portal License) under Acuerdo 11-2016

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente de Panamá (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección Nacional de Verificación del Desempeño
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt/Registration (Category II) – digital intermediation is a low-impact administrative operation; no full EIA Study required. Only submission of an Environmental Compliance statement (Declaración de Cumplimiento Ambiental) for office premises.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge or VOC emissions applicable to a digital portal. For office waste: Decree Law 7 of 1975 (sanitation), Executive Decree-AG-0262-2004 solid waste management, and local sewer discharge limits (IDAAN); compliance with e-waste disposal protocols for IT equipment under Law 6 of 2009.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification required from Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá for all office premises; structural load inspection certificate from the Municipality of Panama's engineering department to confirm the commercial space meets building code occupancy limits; workplace clearance from MITRADEL and CSS for occupational health, including OSHA-equivalent risk assessment for office ergonomics, emergency exit signage, and a minimum of one trained first-aid officer per floor.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas – Sede Electrónica de la DGI, https://www.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima, the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) is obtained by submitting the notarized Public Registry corporate certificate, identification of the resident legal representative, and an initial application to the DGI. Foreign entities not incorporated in Panama must first register a branch in the Public Registry, appoint a resident agent, and then apply for a RUC. There is no separate VAT ID; the RUC serves as the universal taxpayer identification. An aviso de operación municipal may also be required before commencing business.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available under Panamanian law. Taxpayers may elect optional special regimes, including the Multinational Corporate Headquarters (SEM) regime or the simplified small-taxpayer ITBMS system, where eligible. No flow-through or disregarded-entity election exists for a Sociedad Anónima.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/.36,000 annual gross sales of goods or services subject to ITBMS (Balboas, at parity with USD)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica de Panamá, FEP) is phased in for all registered taxpayers. Electronic invoices must be generated in XML, carry a unique cryptographic fiscal code and QR code approved by the DGI, and be transmitted through authorized web services or the DGI portal. Transmission is required within five business days after issuing. There is no real-time clearance in the style of Mexico; however, the DGI validates invoices digitally before fiscal effect.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are zero-rated when physically transported out of Panama. Services are zero-rated when rendered to non-residents, used entirely outside Panama, and paid from abroad with funds entering through the national banking system. An equity crowdfunding portal may zero-rate platform, escrow, or consultancy services if the counterparty is non-resident, the service is performed for a foreign business, and no economic use is deemed to occur within Panama. Documentation must affirm foreign-use and foreign-payment origin.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Service contract and itemized invoice identifying the non-resident beneficiary
Certification of final utilization abroad for services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI will reverse zero-rating if the documentary bundle is incomplete or inconsistent, clumping back all ITBMS credits attributable to the export with annual interest of up to 60%, and administrative fines of up to 50% of the omitted tax. Fraudulent or reckless zero-rating claims may trigger criminal tax-fraud proceedings under Panamanian law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama maintains no issuing central bank. Under the 1904 Monetary Law, the United States Dollar is unlimited legal tender and the Panamanian Balboa (PAB) is a notional unit at parity, issued only as commemorative coinage. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) functions as the banking and monetary supervisory authority, Banco Nacional de Panamá serves as the State's fiscal agent and operator of the SIGA high-value payment system, and the United States Federal Reserve effectively anchors monetary conditions for the jurisdiction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current-account and capital-account convertibility with no exchange-control regime. Dividend, profit, license fee, and investment remittances are freely transmissible in USD or any convertible currency without central bank authorization. The only frictions are standardized AML/CFT verification and reporting under Law 23 of 2015 (including FATCA/CRS classification), plus a 5% dividend tax on profits derived from Panamanian-source income under the territorial tax system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Panama imposes no statutory repatriation, surrender, mandatory conversion, or earmarking requirements on export proceeds, foreign-currency receivables, or cross-border investment receipts. All USD inflows are treated as domestic funds; banks record transactions solely for prudential and AML/CFT surveillance, not for exchange-control enforcement.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-medium viability, strictly as an operational auxiliary. Panamanian crowdfunding regulation under the SMV 'Financiamiento Participativo' regime requires statutory investor funds to be held in dedicated escrow accounts at SBP-licensed banks; offshore digital EMIs cannot serve as primary custody or escrow rails. Foreign EMIs may be used only for non-investor operating disbursements (vendor payments, marketing, international fees), subject to enhanced due diligence, sanctions screening, and unfreezing-risk analysis under Law 23 of 2015 and the FinTech Sandbox framework of Ley 209 de 2021.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person attendance is effectively mandatory for high-risk corporate customers. At least one director and the designated authorized signatory must appear physically before the bank's risk committee or a Panamanian notary public with original passports, corporate documents, and a recent Board Resolution granting signatory powers. A notarized power of attorney, apostilled or legalized, may substitute for non-key directors, but remote video-only onboarding for a licensed crowdfunding portal is not accepted by SBP-regulated Tier-1 banks, and a second biometric identity verification is standard practice.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial ownership of a Panamanian S.A., including historical bearer-share profiles and nominee director structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cancellation certificate for any legacy bearer instruments; fully registered share ledger (Libro de Registro de Acciones) reflecting registered shares; current Registro Público certificate; Registro de Transparencia (Beneficial Ownership Registry) filing for the portal and all intermediate holding entities; Panamanian legal opinion confirming the ownership chain, PIF/PCC structure, and absence of bearer shares.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk fintech classification (ISIC 6499 equity crowdfunding) with cross-border investor funds flowing into escrow accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SMV crowdfunding license/registration certificate; fully executed escrow custody agreement with the SBP-licensed bank; audited financial statements since inception; source-of-funds declaration for seed capital; detailed investor onboarding KYC/AML policy, transaction monitoring procedures, and suspicious-transaction reporting protocols aligned with Law 23/2015 and UAF Resolution guidance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and wire-pattern flags arising from investors residing in multiple high-risk or OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening policy with evidence of screening of each investor (geo-IP verification, passport validation, PEP and adverse-media checks); independent third-party compliance audit; approved jurisdiction whitelist restricting prohibited-country participation; contractual investor representations and undertakings prohibiting restricted groups and terrorist financing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear separation of escrowed investor principal, issuer disbursement, and portal fee income within the same account lineage.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Operational treasury manual distinguishing investor escrow, issuer proceeds, and operating fee sub-accounts; account coding and posting rules; two-man-control disbursement matrix; SMV-mandated periodic transaction reports; cash-flow projections and independent audit confirmation that portal operating funds never commingle with investor escrow funds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound institutional and retail investor funds are received via SWIFT MT103 in USD, EUR, or other convertible currency into the dedicated escrow beneficiary account, with the underlying Crowdfunding Subscription Agreement referenced in SWIFT field 70/72. Panama has no statutory purpose-code classification system, but the bank requires full originator KYC, beneficiary KYC, sanctions screening, and supporting escrow instruction letters. All receipts are cleared in same-day USD via Fedwire/CHIPS correspondent nodes or through Panama's SIGA system for local USD transfers, and are recorded for UAF and SBP supervisory reporting without exchange-control approval.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements to funded issuers, investor refunds, and operational vendors execute via SWIFT MT103 for international payments; domestic USD transfers settle in real time through SIGA (operated by Banco Nacional de Panamá); US-corridor payments clear through Fedwire and CHIPS. Trade settlement for goods or services underlying the equity offering is supported by documentary collections and commercial letters of credit issued or confirmed by the relationship bank. Escrow-to-issuer disbursement occurs only upon SMV-compliant trigger conditions and is evidenced by signed release instructions and a bank-issued distribution report.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EUR and USD/GBP forward contracts executed at the relationship bank's international dealing desk to hedge operating expenses and legal fees
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) against COP, BRL, and MXN to stabilize investor refund cycles from Latin American markets
Cross-currency basis swaps (USD vs EUR) for matched 12-48 month escrow disbursement structures
Plain-vanilla FX options on operational cash flow streams; speculative derivative transactions on investor principal are prohibited by the portal's compliance policy and SMV licensing conditions

stage_5.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all SMV-licensed equity crowdfunding intermediaries regardless of revenue (Ley de Valores / SMV crowdfunding regulation). Non-regulated S.As may opt for an internal Revisor de Cuentas; SMV issuers and financial intermediaries are always audited.
stage_5.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (NIIF) as adopted by SMV for regulated market intermediaries; general S.As may apply IFRS or US GAAP.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday applies to equity crowdfunding portals classified under ISIC 6499. The territorial regime taxes only Panama-source fee income; the general effective rate equals 25% after direct operating expense deductions. Losses can offset future taxable income; no investment or innovation credit is available unless the DGI grants a specific credit under the Tax Code.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 2001 - Declaración Anual de Rentas de Personas Jurídicas (DGI), filed on-line through the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) taxpayer portal (Sistema E-Tax 2.0).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the fiscal year close; for a 31 December fiscal year the return and any tax due are due no later than 31 March. The DGI may grant a one-time extension of up to two months.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: registered legal name, RUC number, DV (verification digit), month of incorporation, address of registered office and fiscal agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the S.A.'s legal identifier in Panama; non-resident directors/beneficial owners must not be listed as resident taxpayers unless they hold a Panama tax ID.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Determination of nature of return: original, amendment, or liquidation/cessation return, with the tax period and foreign-sourced/territorial income election.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mark the appropriate period and confirm that any income relating to services to non-resident issuers is analyzed for Panama-source character before including it as exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross taxable revenue derived from Panama-source activities: platform fees, success fees, escrow/ACH and bank wire facilitation charges, listing and due-diligence fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Panama-source fees; receipts from pure offshore intermediation for non-Panamanian issuers are, in strict territorial analysis, outside this box if not booked or rendered in Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions and costs: direct operating costs, data processing, compliance, personnel, occupancy, depreciation, and ordinary expenses necessary to produce the taxable fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be supported by invoices, empowerment contracts and evidence of payment; non-resident parent administrative charges are deductible only when the transfer-pricing documentation is current.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income and calculation of the 25% corporate income tax, plus the advance/minimum income tax credits and any withholding-tax credits applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tax must be self-assessed; a non-resident-owned S.A. cannot use presumed-foreign tax credits because the territorial system excludes foreign-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Dividend/complementary tax declaration: profits distributed or credited to shareholders, with the 10% or 20% special dividend tax calculation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the profits were subject to 25% tax, withhold 10%; if paid out of tax-exempt or foreign-source reserves, apply the 20% dividend rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of the amount of tax due for each month or fraction, up to 50% of the tax. Late payment: monthly surcharge of 1.5% plus statutory interest. Non-filing with tax evasion intent triggers penalties of up to 100% of omitted tax and, under the Criminal Code, imprisonment of 2 to 5 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed from Panamanian taxable profits subject to corporate income tax; 20% on distributions from exempt or foreign-source profits. No second-level shareholder income tax is imposed on a non-resident shareholder.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before paying a dividend, the non-resident shareholder must supply a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the treaty partner, legalized/apostilled and translated into Spanish, together with a beneficial-ownership declaration. The payer files the treaty relief application (Solicitud de Alivio por Convenio de Doble Imposición) with DGI and obtains acceptance before applying any reduced rate. Absent DGI acceptance, domestic 10%/20% withholding is immediate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory gross-basis withholding on Panama-source payments to non-residents: royalties and other IP license payments 12.5%; debt interest and financing commissions 5%. Treaty rates (commonly 5-10% on dividends, 5-10% on interest, 0-5% on royalties) apply only after DGI confirmation of treaty residence and beneficial ownership.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: The mandatory preparation and submission threshold is set by Executive Decree 210-2020 and DGI implementing forms; a taxpayer must prepare the Local File and Master File and file the annual transfer-pricing return when related-party transaction value or group consolidated turnover exceeds the published threshold. In the current financial-services practice, an equity crowdfunding portal must have contemporaneous documentation as soon as related-party management fees, licensing payments, escrow commissions or intercompany loans in the fiscal year exceed B/.250,000 (PAB, tied 1:1 to USD); actual triggered deadlines follow DGI notices.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama does not maintain a separate ESR code for S.A. companies; however, the equity crowdfunding license (SMV) and general tax registration compel the company to keep a physical seat, local management, payroll/bank accounts and records. A company without economic substance is treated as an unlicensed or dormant shell and loses DTA/tax-evidence protection, even though territorial taxation may not require on-shore activity for non-Panama-source business.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Annual Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly understating Panama-source platform fees, accelerating deductions without invoices, failing to pay the 10%/20% dividend tax on distributions, or omitting Form 2001 filing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Interest and surcharges, 5% monthly late penalties, an understatement surcharge of up to 100% of the omitted tax, closure of operations and criminal tax prosecution under the Criminal Code.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, legal representatives and the resident fiscal agent who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable; the court may order civil restitution, asset seizures, travel bans and imprisonment of 2-5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Nominee-only directors, no physical office or staff, no local bank account, no accounting records and recurring annual tax non-filing; use of the S.A. solely to collect investment funds for non-residents.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution by the Registro Público, cancellation of the commercial license and DGI registration, B/.300 annual corporate tax default penalties and disqualification of the resident agent; public listing as an irregular entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The collapse of limited liability: directors and nominee shareholders may be subjected to civil restitution by creditors/investors and, if assets are funnelled abroad, money-laundering prosecution, travel bans and insolvency disqualification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an equity crowdfunding intermediary, pooling investor funds or holding escrow for startup securities without a license from the Panama Securities Superintendence (SMV), and receiving transactions without adequate KYC/CFT controls.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Securities-market fines and suspension of operations, administrative revocation of the license, AML/CFT sanctions under Ley 23 de 2015, and forfeiture of the illegally collected platform fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are treated as immediate participants in money laundering; they face civil disgorgement, travel bans, pre-trial detention and imprisonment of 5-10 years for predicate securities fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying non-arm's-length management fees or interest to a foreign affiliate, failing to file the DGI transfer-pricing informative return, and having no Local File/Master File for crowdfunding technology or IP contributions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI primary adjustment of taxable income, 30% penalty on the adjustment (or higher for repeated violations), interest and reclassification of the expense as a constructive dividend subject to 10%/20% dividend tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who signed and justified the intercompany arrangement may be held personally liable for the tax shortfall in disregard-of-substance cases; egregious arrangements also attract criminal tax evasion sanctions, travel bans and imprisonment.
